reason: A read-only pre-flight compatibility auditor that statically checks DSH plugin combinations for common startup-conflict signals before installation.

summaries.zh: 这是一个只读的 DSH 插件组合预检工具，用于在安装插件前静态检查常见的启动冲突信号。
summaries.en: A read-only DSH plugin compatibility auditor that statically checks plugin combinations for common startup-conflict signals before installation.

capabilities: Reads the current profile's package.json and cordis.patch.yml
Inspects installed package metadata under node_modules
Detects possible duplicate tool registrations, entry-id collisions, peer-version mismatches, memory-plugin duplication, and missing channel credentials
Provides a read-only compatibility audit without executing audited plugin code
